hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: INV-CIRCUIT-BREAKER-BULKHEAD → the CAPI adapter fails closed (typed ProvisioningError) on management-cluster unreachability; no unbounded retry on the provision path.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: INV-SHUFFLE-SHARDING → per-tenant control-plane provisioning is admission-gated by Cedar (only platform/control-plane-operator may provision; tenants default-deny) before any management-cluster write.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: INV-FOUR-GOLDEN-SIGNALS → provisioning latency + status availability SLIs declared in slos/; saturation surfaced via management-cluster capacity model.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: INV-SLO-ERROR-BUDGET → provisioning-latency + availability error budgets per slos/*.openslo.yaml.

data_classification: INTERNAL_ONLY, AUDIT; tenant-scoped control-plane identity (tenant_id, cluster_name, opaque handle) — no tenant workload data
maturity_non_claim: design-spec maturity (ADR-0376 lane): the kernel + ControlPlaneProvisioning port + in-memory adapter + composition root are BUILT and tested; the kube-rs CAPI adapter's LIVE Kamaji/Talos CRD reconciliation is honest-deferred (registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#kamaji-provider-live-integration). Billing, public SLA, DPIA, and external multi-tenant GA are deferred to oya-managed-k8s-commercial-ga per ADR-0376. All aspirational fields below describe design intent, not runtime behavior.
explicit_non_claims: No provider-live Kamaji/Talos/CAPI reconciliation, provider actuation, tenant workload hosting, or production readiness is implemented by this manifest.
The live CAPI adapter boundary remains honest-deferred behind kamaji-provider-live-integration; any provider-facing method must fail closed until that follow-on lands.
Hyperscaler inventory fields describe contract intent and local fail-closed seams only, not measured runtime readiness or live control-plane fleet operation.
